notes: Official mongo:7 image (7.0.x). mongo:8 (8.3.9) refuses to start on this host's Linux 7.0.0 kernel (SERVER-121912: TCMalloc rseq incompatibility with kernels 6.19-7.0.13, exits at startup, no bypass) so the lab pins 7.0. 3-member replica set rs0 (priorities 3/2/1) initiated by a one-shot mongosh container; no auth. Per-node targets use directConnection=true; writes w=1 unless an experiment says otherwise. $vectorSearch is Atlas / mongot-only, so vector_knn is unsupported on Community.

strategy.tool: mongodump --oplog --gzip --archive (logical, cluster-consistent thanks to the oplog captured during the dump); physical alternative: fsyncLock + volume snapshot
strategy.consistency: point-in-time at the end of the dump (--oplogReplay applies the oplog captured while dumping)
strategy.restore: online: dropDatabase, then mongorestore --oplogReplay --drop against the primary (secondaries replicate the restore); --oplogReplay cannot be combined with namespace filters
strategy.incremental: none in Community tooling; Percona PBM does physical + incremental + selective restores
strategy.pitr: oplog-based — keep the oplog window (replSetResizeOplog) longer than the backup interval; PBM/Ops Manager tail it continuously
strategy.schedule: cron / CronJob running mongodump on a secondary (readPreference=secondary) or PBM's scheduler
strategy.retention: external: archives are self-contained files; PBM has retention policies

physical_alternative.method: fsyncLock + cp -a /data/db + fsyncUnlock (stand-in for a volume snapshot)
